about_the_game:
DWARF MINER: The Lost Scroll

Descend into the depths in DWARF MINER: The Lost Scroll, an exciting 2D mining adventure! Take control of a brave dwarf on a mission to recover an ancient scroll hidden deep underground. Dig through layers of rock, uncover hidden treasures.

Upgrade your tools, manage your resources, and navigate treacherous caves filled with traps and secrets. Will you uncover the scroll before it's lost forever?

💎 Features:

  • Exciting Mining Gameplay – Dig deeper and uncover the mysteries below.

  • Upgrade Your Gear – Improve your tools to mine faster and survive longer.

  • Hidden Treasures & Secrets – Discover lost relics and powerful artifacts.

  • Pixel-Art Adventure – Beautifully crafted 2D visuals with a retro vibe.

  • 3-4 Hours of Gameplay – A compact but thrilling adventure that tests your skills and endurance.

Prepare to dig, explore, and fight your way to the ultimate treasure! Will you reclaim the lost scroll, or will the depths consume you?

This game only saves your achievements. If you want to collect them all, You must complete your journey in a single run. No second chances!
